profiles.label: Ordinary learner · teaching routes
profiles.description: Synthetic zero-axis profile carrying invitations to two curricula. These are teaching opportunities, not learned skills.

profiles.label: Archive keeper · teaching and blueprint
profiles.description: Synthetic zero-axis profile joining an apprenticeship route with a transferable lamp drawing. It provides no lamp.

profiles.label: Affinity potential · biological and resonant
profiles.description: Synthetic one-axis profile for testing two distinct Affinity-potential provenance routes. It has no active axis access.

profiles.label: Techfinity potential · biological and blueprint
profiles.description: Synthetic one-axis profile joining experimental biological compatibility and a transferable interface specification. No installation occurs.

profiles.label: Dual potential · independent route pair
profiles.description: Synthetic two-axis profile. The four records remain independent traits; their combination creates no third system.

profiles.label: Mentorship conductor · resonance and curriculum
profiles.description: Synthetic one-axis profile distinguishing a resonant potential route from a device-care mentorship invitation.

profiles.label: Fabricated successor · blueprint routes
profiles.description: Synthetic successor record for transferring blueprints, not an asserted species, bloodline, assembled body, or installed device.

profiles.label: Mixed route · biological, resonant, taught, fabricated
profiles.description: Synthetic two-axis candidate used to inspect cross-channel branching. Its inherited records never teach skills or activate systems.

traits.label: Affinity compatibility candidate
traits.description: Experimental biological potential marker. It asserts neither a real gene nor a canonical source of Affinity access.

traits.label: Techfinity compatibility candidate
traits.description: Experimental biological compatibility marker, separate from Affinity. It grants no installed interface or active access.

traits.label: Affinity resonance candidate
traits.description: Experimental transmission through a resonant relationship. Resonant succession is not assumed to be biological descent.

traits.label: Techfinity resonance candidate
traits.description: Experimental Techfinity-potential record transmitted by resonance. Its activation mechanism remains unresolved.

traits.label: Spell-practice mentorship invitation
traits.description: A cultural route to seek instruction in an ordinary spell procedure. The learner must still purchase and practice M0.

traits.label: Device-practice mentorship invitation
traits.description: A route to instruction in ordinary device handling. It transfers no learned ranks, equipment, charges, or axis access.

traits.label: Interface compatibility specification
traits.description: A transferable experimental design specifying a possible compatibility route. Fabrication, installation, and access remain separate decisions.

traits.label: Ordinary lamp drawing
traits.description: A transferable ordinary-device drawing, not a lamp, fabricated object, learned operating skill, or Techfinity requirement.

rules.description: Synthetic hash-gated succession for testing provenance and branching. Fractions are arbitrary fixture thresholds, not biological estimates or approved universal laws. All branches are suggestions with no runtime grants.

biological.description: Each eligible potential marker passes its own deterministic gate. No dominant/recessive, species, sex, or ancestry taxonomy is inferred.

resonant.description: Tests a separate resonant transmission route. It is neither biological certainty nor proof of active system access.

cultural_mentorship.description: Transfers a teaching invitation or curriculum provenance. It never copies skill mastery, growth points, or axis access.

fabricated_blueprint.description: Transfers design provenance only. Potential specifications and ordinary drawings remain distinct; neither installs hardware.

interactions.label: Taught spell and ordinary drawing
interactions.description: A candidate route for later ordinary magic plus ordinary technology experimentation. The composition variant is a boundary test, not an extra installed skill.

interactions.label: Affinity potential and ordinary drawing
interactions.description: Suggests a one-axis hybrid experiment after instruction, resources, equipment, and independently supplied Affinity access. It grants none of those requirements.

interactions.label: Taught spell and interface potential
interactions.description: Suggests a one-axis hybrid experiment using ordinary magic and a Techfinity expression. Teaching provenance does not satisfy learned prerequisites.

interactions.label: Independent expression pairing
interactions.description: A candidate to test the approved two-axis recipe. Both axis access facts and every learned prerequisite must still be supplied independently during play.
